# Tucker Family Charity

> Supporting education and community development at Oliver's Village school near Benoni, South Africa.

## Overview

Tucker Family Charity is a family-led nonprofit based in Johannesburg, South Africa. The charity creates practical opportunities and supports vulnerable communities through partnership, action, and shared purpose — from Oliver's Village to broader community programmes.

## Intended audience

- People who want to donate, volunteer, or support charity programmes in South Africa
- Families and communities seeking trusted local services via Keep It In The Family
- Partners, sponsors, and businesses interested in property, golf learnership, or event collaborations
- Job seekers and employers using the Work Opportunities network

## Main capabilities

- Education and community support at Oliver's Village (Putfontein, Benoni)
- Charity shop: personalised hats, wine, and partner offers
- Events and fundraising activities
- Keep It In The Family: community service directory and curated resource library
- Golf Learnership Programme (with Afrika Tikkun)
- Property partnerships and listings
- Work Opportunities: candidate profiles and available roles
